summary: Content in phaser/src/data/content is small, hand-authored JSON: 161 cards, 13 classes, 49 items, 3 regions, 14 dialogue trees (57 nodes, ~980 words), 2 quests, 3 encounter tables (31 entries, 9 inline check events), 1 standalone check event, 9 enemy groups, 11 enemy-AI profiles, 5 dungeon defs (4 room events), 5 town defs, 3 live overworld sheets (46 nodes / 62 edges / 4 region edges) plus 1 dead legacy map, 1 unconsumed scaling-curve stub, and 9 rejected hand-pixel sprite JSONs. Zod schemas exist for every type (src/data/schemas/*.ts) but src/data/load.ts validateContent() has ZERO callers: at runtime every JSON is imported raw with `as` casts and hand-registered in seven separate per-screen Record tables (TownScene, OverworldScene, seedGroupBattle, seedDungeonBattle, dialogueBootstrap, questEngine, enemyAI, BattleEndModal), and scripts/lint-content.ts only cross-checks class→card and dialogue→node refs, so dangling classIds (bandit_priest, cleric, bounty_hunter), mismatched node encounterTableIds, unreachable dungeons and town nodes without defs all ship silently. The gear catalog (items+cards) is the most complete slice and matches ship-plan §7 exactly (46 gear + 3 consumables), with every engine-unsupported card faithfully approximated and documented in docs/research/gear-content-deviations.md; classes, enemy groups, enemy AI, regions, towns, dungeons and the three overworld sheets are complete enough to port verbatim, while dialogue/quests/prologue and the whole cast (Roy/Marcus/Lilina/Kael/Daren) are Fire-Emblem placeholder names that the committed story bible (Corwin Vale / Mercer Kaine / Bagrat "Oak") supersedes. Art: 18 ComfyUI character renders at 832x1216 (12.7MB) with 18 box-filtered 104x152 board bakes (311KB), 4 painterly 1536x512 region backdrops, 4 decoration plates, a 4-biome 128px dual-grid terrain set (60 tiles cut from 4 seamless masters) plus a 61-tile 64px blob autotile set for the combat board, self-hosted Cinzel + EB Garamond woff2, and an empty audio dir; 41MB of ComfyUI candidates under public/sprites/lab and 5.8MB of unused building sprites are pure weight. Keep the data (ids, numbers, prompts/seeds), the item/dialogue/checkEvent refine rules, the sprite-lookup contract, and the deviations doc; drop the dead loader, the name-keyed portrait registry, the pixel toolkit, the lab gallery, template icons and the legacy converters. Balance numbers are unbalanced on purpose: the 2026-08-28 rebaseline shows 100% win everywhere, so port numbers verbatim only as a starting point and tune threat UP.

requirements.text: Gear IS the deck: items of kind weapon|shield|tome|staff MUST carry gearCardIds (>=1); quivers MUST NOT carry gearCardIds and are the ONLY kind allowed a quiverModifier {kind: poison|slow|thunder|explosive, value, turns}. Enforced today by ItemSchema.superRefine.

Card shape: {id, name, apCost>=0, effects:[{kind, params}], range:{min,max}, targetKind: enemy|ally|self|tile (all_enemies/all_allies exist in schema but have no runtime path), aoeRadius?, weaponType: null|sword|lance|axe|bow|crossbow|tome|staff|greatsword|dagger|shield, damageStat?: str|mag|skl}. Effect kinds actually authored: Damage{base, damageType?:'magic'}, Heal{amount}, GrantArmor{amount, magic?, scalesWithShield?}, ApplyStatus{effectId, value?, turns, splash?:'adjacent'}, RemoveStatus{kind:'armor'|'debuff', amount?|all?}, DrawCards{count, gainAp?}, GainAp{amount, target?:'ally'}, Move{distance}. weaponType null = innate class card.

Status effect ids referenced by content are exactly: poison, burn, slow, immobilize, taunt, riposte, empower (all registered in systems/statusEffects.ts). Burn stacks; poison/slow/immobilize refresh (higher value wins). No chance to resist.

Class shape: {id, name, baseStats{str,mag,skl,spd,def,res,lck}, growthRates (same 7 keys, percent — UNUSED by buildUnit today), innateCardIds[], startingMov>=1, startingHp>=1}. Every class must have at least one innate Damage card (lint warning) and every innateCardId must exist in cards.json (lint error).

Dialogue choice is EITHER {next} OR {check + onPass + onFail} (never both); next/onPass/onFail are node ids or the literal 'end'; nodes have optional speaker (empty/undefined = narrator), text, choices[], onEnter effects[]. Choices may carry visibleIf/enabledIf predicates and effects[]. startNodeId must be a node; every branch target must be a node or 'end' (lint errors).

CheckEvent: {id, title, description, choices[>=1]} where a choice = {id, text, check?, onPass:{narration, effects[]}, onFail?} and a choice WITH a check MUST define onFail. CheckRequirement union: stat{stat: str|mag|skl|spd|def|res|lck, threshold} | class{classId} | gold{amount} | food{amount}. Check events are authored INLINE inside encounter-table entries and dungeon roomEvents; standalone checkEvents/*.json is only used for enemy-group victoryEvent.

Predicate vocabulary (recursive): always | never | flag{key, equals?} | notFlag{key} | questStage{questId, stage} | questComplete{questId} | partyHas{classId} | goldAtLeast{amount} | visited{ref} | cleared{encounterId} | allOf{preds} | anyOf{preds} | not{pred}. Content actually uses: flag, notFlag, questStage, goldAtLeast, allOf, anyOf, always.

QuestEffect vocabulary: setFlag{key,value,scope?: run|quest|battle|permanent} | recruitUnit{classId,level} | spawnNode{ref} | unlockNode{ref} | startDialogue{treeId} | completeQuest{questId} | addGold{amount (may be negative)} | addItem{itemId} | addFood{amount} | damageParty{amount} | healParty{percent 0..1} | statCheck{stat,threshold,successEffects,failEffects} | advanceQuestStage{questId,toStage} | startCombat{enemyGroupId}. MapNodeRef = {mapKind: overworld|dungeon|battle, mapId, nodeId}.

Quest = {id, name, initialStage, stages{[id]: {id, onEnter[], listeners[{on: BattleVictory|LocationArrived|FlagSet, predicate, emit[]}], transitions[{when, to}], onExit[]}}}. Both shipped quests are flag-driven (daren_captured/daren_killed/blood_ties_reward_claimed; caravan_supplies_found/caravan_reward_claimed). Pick ONE completion idiom in the rebuild — today blood_ties transitions to a '__complete__' stage while missing_caravan uses a completeQuest effect.

Encounter table = {id, regionId?, entries[{id, weight>0, oneShot, conditions: Predicate[], outcome}]}; outcome union = dialogue{dialogueId} | battle{enemyGroupId, captureTargets?[{unitId, capturedDialogueId, killedDialogueId, capturedFlag, killedFlag}]} | checkEvent{event: inline CheckEvent}. Quest-gated entries use weight 90-100 + oneShot so they fire next roll once their questStage/flag conditions hold.

EnemyGroup = {id, name, members[{id?, name, classId, level, count, isCaptureTarget?, bountyValue?}], victoryEvent?}. member.id is the STABLE unit id: used verbatim when count=1, suffixed `_N` when count>1; it drives sprite lookup and quest capturedIds matching. Omitted id -> generated `<groupId>_<idx>` with class-fallback art. Seeders spawn at level = max(member.level, nodeLevel).

Sprite lookup contract: spriteIdForUnit(unitId, classId) = UNIT_ID_SPRITES[unitId] ?? UNIT_ID_SPRITES[unitId minus one trailing _N] ?? CLASS_FALLBACK_SPRITE[classId] ?? null (null = shape token). NEVER key art on display names. Portraits load /sprites/units/<id>.png (832x1216); the board loads /sprites/units/board/<id>.png (104x152, ÷8 alpha-weighted box filter) with LINEAR filtering — scaling originals under pixelArt nearest sampling was the 'pixelated characters' bug.

Enemy AI profile per class: {classId, role: rusher|archer|healer|tank, movement, preferredRange?{min,max}, actions[{id, kind: attack|heal, range{min,max}, amount, damageStat: str|mag|skl|null, weight, situation?: always|self_low_hp|ally_wounded|target_low_hp, aoeRadius?}]}. Enemies play these synthesized actions, NOT their class deck — so enemy poison/burn never fire today; the rebuild should make enemies deck-driven or add status to actions.

Region = {id, name, color #rrggbb, tier 1..3}. Tier sets the enemy level band (1->[1,2], 2->[3,4], 3->[5,6], deterministic per-node salt picks within band) and shop rarity gate (borderlands common+uncommon; thornwood/ashfall uncommon+rare; epic/legendary never sold). Shop stock = town.shopStockIds ∪ region:'none' food/potion ∪ items whose region == town.regionId within the allowed rarities.

Town = {id, name, description, regionId?, innHealCostPerUnit>=1, shopStockIds[], rumors[], tavernQuests[{questId, npcName, npcDescription, dialogueId, visibleIf?}], recruits?[{id, name, classId, level, description?, costOverride?, visibleIf?}], blacksmithEnabled, arenaLocked, arenaLockedText?}. Recruit price = round(baseClassCost × (1 + (level-1) × 0.5)) unless costOverride.

Dungeon = {id, name, regionId, floors (all 3), theme, combatEnemyGroupId, eliteEnemyGroupId, bossEnemyGroupId, roomEvents?: CheckEvent[] pool for event rooms}. Every overworld 'dungeon' node id must resolve to a dungeon def (today only smugglers_cave is reachable; ancient_ruins/thornwood_depths/iron_mine/obsidian_cavern are registered for seeding but DungeonScene hard-codes smugglers_cave).

Overworld sheet = {id, regionId, name, width, height, nodes[{id, name, type: town|camp|dungeon|exit, sigil?: render-only glyph override (waypoint|fortress|dungeon|boss|shrine|battle|bridge), position{x,y} in sheet pixels, spawnPoint?, encounterTableId?}], edges[{from,to,encounterTableId,rollChance}], regionEdges?[{fromMapId,fromNodeId,toMapId,toNodeId,rollChance}]}. Gameplay keys off `type`; sigil only changes the drawn NodeMapSymbol. Owner decision (2026-08): ONE open sheet — merge the 3 region sheets, keep regionId per node.

Every node-type town must have a TownDef and every node-type dungeon a DungeonDef, and every encounterTableId/dialogueId/enemyGroupId/questId/classId/itemId/cardId reference must resolve — checked by a content lint at build time, not at click time. Today lint only checks class→card and dialogue→node; the rebuild's lint must cover all cross-refs (towns: thornwood_chapel and ashfall_outpost have NO def and fall back to pine_crossing; borderkeep_castle and northern_bridge defs have NO node).

Validate ALL content with the Zod schemas at boot (or in a build step) and fail loudly. data/load.ts validateContent() exists but is never called; content is consumed via raw JSON imports + `as` casts in 7 hand-maintained registries.

Starter party: roy (lord, L1, handLeft iron_sword), marcus (knight, L1, iron_lance + iron_buckler), lilina (mage, L1, fire_tome); gear starts EQUIPPED in hand slots, not in the bag; a missing item id degrades to innate-only rather than crashing. Names/ids are FE placeholders — the story bible's locked cast (Corwin Vale captain, Mercer Kaine traitor, Bagrat 'Oak' first companion) should replace them.

Battle loot: on victory 40% chance of exactly one hand-slot gear item; rarity by strongest defeated enemy level: L1-2 80/20 common/uncommon, L3-4 50/40/10 C/U/R, L5+ 30/50/20 U/R/E; roll falls through to the next lower rarity if the pool is empty.

Enemy scaling is gear-pace (party has NO levels): hp = baseHp + (lvl-1)×2; str/def/mag +1 every 2 levels; skl/spd/res +1 every 3; lck flat. Party recruits use buildUnit: +1 to every positive base stat per level above 1, hp = startingHp + 3/level, ap 3. growthRates are unused.

Item grid sizes for the grid inventory: 1x1 (buckler, tomes, dagger, quivers, potions, bark shield, aegis, shadowfang), 1x2 (1H swords/lances/axes/crossbows, staves, tower shields, food), 1x3 (1H bows), 2x3 (two-handed greatswords/longbows). twoHanded items occupy handLeft and lock handRight; a quiver only works opposite a 1H bow.

Character portraits: keyed today by dialogue speaker DISPLAY NAME (characters.ts KNOWN map, 22 entries, hash-to-identity-ramp fallback for unknown speakers, 8-token --id-* accent ramp, faction -> portrait shape). Rebuild should key speakers on unit/character ids and derive sprite from unitSprites, keeping the deterministic on-palette fallback for unknown speakers.

Content-lint rules to preserve: ERROR if class innate card id not in cards.json; ERROR if dialogue startNodeId is not a node; ERROR if any choice next/onPass/onFail (other than 'end') is not a node; WARN if a class has no innate Damage card (a lone unit of it cannot win). Runs as `npm run lint:content` inside `npm run verify`; currently passes with 0 errors / 0 warnings.

Overworld encounter table is selected by map.regionId (MAPS/ENCOUNTER_TABLES keyed borderlands|thornwood|ashfall), NOT by node/edge encounterTableId — the sheets say 'thornwood_road'/'ashfall_road' while the tables are 'thornwood_path'/'ashfall_track'. Rebuild: either drop per-node table ids or make them the source of truth and lint them.

Fonts: self-hosted Cinzel (display, 400-700) and EB Garamond (body, normal 400-600 + italic 400-500), latin + latin-ext woff2 subsets via public/fonts/fonts.css, linked from index.html — no CDN. Keep as-is.

Terrain art contract: overworld TerrainCanvas draws 4 biomes (water, grass, dirt, stone; draw order water<dirt<stone<grass) as 128px dual-grid marching-squares sets — `<biome>.png` (opaque, cfg 15) + `<biome>_1..14.png` (feathered transitions, 4-bit corner config TL=1,TR=2,BL=4,BR=8) — plus 4 decoration plates (pine, tree, bush, rock). Combat board draws px_grass ground + a 47-case blob autotile of dirt (`px_dirt`, `px_dirt_edge_n|outer_nw|b<missingOrth>_<notchDiag>`) at 64px.

Character/prop art comes from LOCAL ComfyUI (waiIllustrious SDXL + DarkFantasy-PixelSprite LoRA trigger DFSV1, RemBG alpha), not hand-drawn; prompts + seeds for every shipped sprite are recorded in public/sprites/lab/manifest.json and scripts/cli/comfy/*.json. Rebuild should keep the prompt/seed record so art can be regenerated for the new cast.
